title: Magic Firework common definitions
description: Shared definitions for inks, shows and firework profiles. Ranges mirror ContentLimits, Attributes and FireworkLimits; keep them in sync when those change.

id.description: Namespaced content id, e.g. magic-firework:ring. Both halves must be lower case; the colon is required.

rot.description: Euler angles in degrees, applied as Ry * Rx * Rz.

scale.description: Uniform scale. Values <= 0 fall back to 1.0 at runtime.
